notes: Generated enlarged visual drafts. Validate the native grid, master palette and animation before game integration.

characters.name: Max
characters.brief: Max Rockatansky from Mad Max, short tousled brown hair, tiny dark stubble cluster, battered near-black leather jacket, one muted gray shoulder patch, dark brown trousers and boots. No weapon, no dog, no car.

characters.name: Rick
characters.brief: Rick Grimes from The Walking Dead in his early sheriff look: tan wide-brim sheriff hat, short brown hair, tiny dark stubble, muted bone/tan uniform shirt, dark brown belt and pants, a single dull gray badge pixel. No weapon.

characters.name: Ellie
characters.brief: Ellie Williams from The Last of Us: auburn hair tied into a tiny short ponytail contained within frame, muted dusty red short-sleeve shirt over gray neckline, blue-gray jeans, brown boots. No weapon, no writing or graphic on shirt, no large backpack.

characters.name: Jill
characters.brief: Jill Valentine in her classic Resident Evil look: small muted steel-blue beret, short brown bob, pale slate-blue shirt and dark blue tactical vest/shoulder straps, gray-blue trousers and dark boots. No weapon and no unreadable insignia.

characters.name: Leon
characters.brief: Leon S. Kennedy in his classic Resident Evil 2 police uniform: simple side-swept light brown fringe, steel-blue police suit with dark blue vest, muted gray chest patch and belt, dark boots. No weapon, no RPD lettering.

characters.name: Niran
characters.brief: An original lean adult pathfinder with short black hair, muted olive field shirt, bone neck cloth represented by one small cluster, brown trousers, dark boots. A dark diagonal compass strap. Face calm and alert.

characters.name: Mali
characters.brief: An original woman field medic with a simple short dark bob, bone canvas jacket, oxidized teal shirt and trousers, muted red upper-arm patch as one square, dark boots. Keep her distinct from the reference nurse by removing cap and chest cross.

characters.name: Boon
characters.brief: An original older dark-skinned man diesel mechanic, short gray flat-top hair, tiny gray mustache cluster, steel-blue overalls over a muted rust undershirt, dull brown belt, dark boots. No hat and no handheld tool.

characters.name: Dao
characters.brief: An original woman radio operator with short auburn bob, one compact dark headset earpiece contained against head, slate-blue jacket with bone collar, brown belt, dark gray pants. One tiny muted steel radio clip on belt, no antenna sticking outside frame.

characters.name: Lek
characters.brief: An original middle-aged cook with a simple bone rag head wrap, dark skin, muted gray apron over a bone shirt, rust brown trousers and dark boots. One darker apron pocket as a 2-pixel cluster. No tall chef hat or utensils.

characters.name: Arun
characters.brief: An original salvage diver with a fitted dark olive rubber cap, medium-brown skin, oxidized teal waterproof work jacket with dull bone neck seal, dark teal pants and black boots. No oxygen tank, no mask over face, no fins.

characters.name: Ploy
characters.brief: An original young woman botanist with muted blonde hair in a short tucked ponytail, olive-green overalls over bone short sleeves, brown boots and belt. One small olive pocket flap, no plants held in hands.

characters.name: Somchai
characters.brief: An original welder with a flat mustard hardhat and compact raised soot-gray welding visor over brow, medium tan skin, dark rust work apron over slate blue shirt, gray trousers, dark boots. Visor must not obscure the simple right-facing face; no torch.

characters.name: Mae
characters.brief: An original elderly woman quartermaster, short silver-gray hair with one small tucked braid shape, bone utility vest over muted brown sleeves, dark brown belt and tiny square hip pouch, olive-gray trousers, dark boots. No glasses or handheld props.

characters.name: Ken
characters.brief: An original dark-skinned guard with fitted soot-black combat helmet and one muted olive stripe, dark olive armored tunic, bone single chest patch, charcoal trousers and brown boots. No gun, no shield; keep shape compact.

characters.name: Nok
characters.brief: An original runner with black short hair and muted rust-red bandana, faded blue sleeveless shirt, rust-brown trousers, dark belt and boots. Athletic but same reference chunky proportions; bare forearms use medium tan skin.

characters.name: Isha
characters.brief: An original woman lab scientist with dark brown skin and compact short curly black hair silhouette, bone short lab jacket over muted teal shirt, slate-blue pants, dark boots. Small dark collar seam; no glasses, vial or logo.

characters.name: Tomas
characters.brief: An original bald older man water engineer with tiny dark square beard cluster, warm tan skin, muted teal maintenance jumpsuit, rust-brown tool belt and one dull gray buckle, charcoal boots. No cap or external tool.

characters.name: June
characters.brief: An original woman electrician with dark brown short hair under a faded steel-blue work cap, muted mustard work jacket over blue overalls, simple dark belt, brown boots. One dull gray jacket seam; no lightning symbol or handheld tool.

characters.name: Viktor
characters.brief: An original older man driver with dark gray close-fitting fur cap with short ear flaps, pale weathered skin, dusty snow-blue winter coat with bone collar, charcoal trousers and brown boots, tiny gray beard cluster. Keep coat narrow like the original body.
